fork.grip: origin = fist centre on the handle; tines +X, 0.20 m long
fork.note: brushed bistro steel, 4 tines with gaps, bevelled handle

knife.grip: origin = fist centre on the handle; blade +X, edge -Y, 0.27 m
knife.note: wood handle with 3 brass rivets, steel bolster, serrated blade

salt_shaker.grip: origin = fist centre at 40 % height; cap +Z (turn it over to salt)
salt_shaker.note: 8-facet glass, salt inside, chrome cap with 7 holes; 12 cm

hacksaw.grip: origin = fist centre on the pistol grip; blade teeth down, cuts toward +X; 0.50 m
hacksaw.note: blue tube frame, 70-tooth blade on pins, wing-nut tension screw, wood grip

sugar_tongs.grip: origin = fist centre at the spring bow; claws +X; 11 cm
sugar_tongs.note: silver-plate arms, spring bow, 3-claw ends, gilt engraving line

metal_bites.grip: pick one by name bite_0..5 (sugar tongs, fork tines); each 3-4 cm, 1.5 mm sheet
metal_bites.note: white or navy painted face, aluminium cut edges, rivet heads on 3, a navy stripe on 1

plate.note: porcelain white like the Cessna skin, raised rim, silver rim line, foot ring

oil_glass.grip: origin = fist centre on the stem; bowl +Z; 18.5 cm
oil_glass.note: clear glass, amber mineral oil #f0a81c, thin stem, round foot, rim highlight

water_jug.grip: origin = jug foot centre; grips: right hand on jug_handle (x -0.12, z 0.17), left under the spout; tumbler at +0.22 m
water_jug.note: jug 28 cm with handle + spout + bubbles; tumbler 10 cm, water lines

kitchen_scale.grip: ground = table top; dial faces -Y; needle node scale_needle (pivot = scale_needle_hub, 0..4 lb over 300 deg)
kitchen_scale.note: cream enamel 1970s body, chrome bezel + pan, lb ticks 0-4, printed mark "2 lb / 900 g", black needle on 2 lb

dessert_trolley.grip: ground = trolley castors; push bar at -X (Michel pushes/rings from there); tiers bottom->top: bike, cart, TV, coffin topper (node coffin_*)
dessert_trolley.note: two-shelf chrome/maple trolley with gallery rails + castors; 3-tier cream cake with blue piping + swirls; teal bike, wire cart, wood 1970s TV, polished coffin

cloche_bell.grip: cloche origin = plate centre (lift by cloche_knob); bell at +0.30 m, grip = bell_handle_knob
cloche_bell.note: cloche 33 cm polished silver with rolled rim + knob; table bell with wood knob

record_book.grip: both hands on the long edges; cover up +Z; 24 x 31 cm
record_book.note: navy cloth cover, gilt BOOK OF / RECORDS + rule + medal, ivory page block, round spine

certificate.grip: both hands on the sides; faces -Y; two versions: cert_* (whole) at x 0, cert_bitten_* (corner bitten, DIET 30.4) at x +0.5
certificate.note: brushed steel frame, ivory paper, navy STRANGEST DIET EVER / MONSIEUR MANGETOUT, gold seal + navy ribbons, hanging wire; no Guinness logo

owner_rag_spanner.grip: rag origin = pinch point (owner's hand, polishing); spanner at +0.35 m, grip = shaft centre
owner_rag_spanner.note: 36 cm yellow cotton rag with folds + weave; chrome combination spanner (ring + open jaw)

airline_tray.grip: ground = tray table; foil lid node meal_foil_lid (lift on 31.44); 34 x 25 cm
airline_tray.note: grey-beige compartment tray, grey meal + peas, crinkled foil lid, bread roll, plastic cutlery pack
